[1] faq.md > Can I pick my order up instead?
### Can I pick my order up instead?

Yes, at the Frederick showroom only. Choose curbside pickup at checkout and your order is ready
within 2 hours during store hours, Monday through Saturday 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Pickup is free.
The Annapolis showroom does not offer curbside pickup.

[2] shipping.md > Curbside pickup
## Curbside pickup

Curbside pickup is available at the Frederick showroom only, at 412 East Patrick Street. It is
free and orders are ready within 2 hours of being placed during showroom hours (Monday to
Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM ET). An order placed after 4:00 PM is ready the next morning.
The customer receives a "ready for pickup" email, parks in the loading zone on East Patrick
Street and calls the showroom; staff bring the order out. Pickup orders are held for 7 days,
after which they are cancelled and refunded.

The Annapolis showroom does not offer curbside pickup; its stock is not connected to the online
store's inventory. Customers near Annapolis can order online and have the order shipped, or buy
from the showroom floor.

Fuel may be collected curbside, which is the simplest way for a Frederick customer to buy it.

[3] faq.md > Can I return something at a showroom?
### Can I return something at a showroom?

Yes, at either the Frederick or the Annapolis showroom. Bring the packing slip or the order number
and the showroom will process the return on the spot.

[4] showrooms.md > Services
### Services

Repair drop-off: bring the lantern to the register. We open the repair ticket and hold the lantern
in the back room. Annapolis repairs are shipped to the Hagerstown Repair Center once a week, on
Tuesdays, so an Annapolis drop-off takes about a week longer than one in Frederick. Fuel lanterns
must be empty; Annapolis has no drain tray, so please empty the lantern at home first.

There is no curbside pickup at Annapolis, and no wick-trimming clinic. Online orders cannot be
collected here. Customers who want to collect an order should choose Curbside pickup, Frederick, or
have it shipped.

In-store returns are accepted with the packing slip or the order number, and no RA number is
needed.

[5] shipping.md > Rates and delivery times
## Rates and delivery times

All orders ship from the warehouse at 1180 Downsville Pike, Hagerstown, MD 21740. Delivery times
are in business days (Monday to Friday, excluding the six company holidays) and count from the
day the order leaves the warehouse, not the day it was placed.

| Service   | Cost                             | Delivery time         | Same-day cutoff |
|-----------|----------------------------------|-----------------------|-----------------|
| Standard  | $6.95, free on orders of $75 or more | 3 to 6 business days | 2:00 PM ET    |
| Expedited | $14.95                           | 2 business days       | 2:00 PM ET      |
| Overnight | $29.95                           | Next business day     | 1:00 PM ET      |
| Canada    | $19.95 flat                      | 5 to 10 business days | 2:00 PM ET      |
